author: Kai Orion & Sandlada
description: Monorepo for the Material Web Snippets and Material Design CSS Snippets VS Code extensions (md-* components + Material Design 3 CSS design tokens: color, palette, typescale, shape, motion, space).
name: material-vscode-extension-monorepo

scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run verify
scripts.generate: npm run build:tools && npm run generate -w packages/material-web-snippets && npm run generate -w packages/material-design-css-snippets
scripts.generate:check: npm run build:tools && npm run generate:check -w packages/material-web-snippets && npm run generate:check -w packages/material-design-css-snippets
scripts.generate:stdout: npm run build:tools && npm run generate:stdout -w packages/material-web-snippets && npm run generate:stdout -w packages/material-design-css-snippets
scripts.package:all: npm run build && npm run package -w packages/material-web-snippets && npm run package -w packages/material-design-css-snippets
scripts.verify: npm run build:tools && npm run verify -w packages/material-web-snippets && npm run verify -w packages/material-design-css-snippets
